name: Instruction Status 14 Choice
definition: Status applying globally to the instruction received.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Status advising on the processing of the instruction.

Rejected.name: Rejected
Rejected.definition: Status advising on the rejection of the instruction and on the reason for the rejection.

Pending.name: Pending
Pending.definition: Status advising that the instruction is pending and advising on the reason for the pending status.
